top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a clean prediction-to-discovery chain: the Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model fixed a magic angle with vanishing Dirac velocity and flat bands, and the 2018 experiments then found correlated insulators and superconductivity there, a genuinely new regime that the theory did not itself predict. The phases are reproduced by many groups with transport, STM and compressibility probes, and a citation limited to flat bands and observed phases does not depend on the unsettled pairing mechanism. The residual weakness is attribution (Andrei, Cao, earlier twisted-bilayer theory), which I judge does not displace the three named. P002 (optical lattice clock) is a mature, cross-checked two-name allocation but is closer to a measurement capability overlapping the 2005 and 2012 prizes, so I rank it second, above no award.
recusal_note: No conflict with any laureate in P001 or P002 apparent from profile. As director of WACQT and a Chalmers superconducting-circuit theorist I have a declared connection to circuit QED (B046), which is not in the slate. General closeness to the quantum community only.
